part: C: Hyrule under the sea, from the warp in to the castle battle after the Master Sword (before leaving: 0x3810 is the next arc's)

steps.label: The warp down to Hyrule

switches.why: spawn switch of Hyrule's event warp_out (EVNT entry 0), which Hyrule point 200 starts the first time (dEvent_exception_c::setStartDemo, d_event_manager.cpp:41-48)

restart.evidence: Hyrule's save table is 9 (SAVE_HYRULE), so saving writes the stage's exit 0: Hyrule room 0 point 0 (dComIfGs_setGameStartStage; wwedit.disc_restart_places)

evidence: ADMumi's event warp_in: its PACKAGE/PLAY cut has EventFlag 11536 (0x2D10) and changes scene to Hyrule point 200, layer 8 (ADMumi Stage.arc event_list.dat; the decomp's note: 'Set by warp_in.stb (stage: ADMumi)')

Hyrule point 200 (parameters 0x00FF0000) starts warp_out (EVNT 0, spawn switch 0x02); warp_out's PLAY goes to Hyrule point 201, layer 0; daWarphr_c watches for it (dComIfGp_evmng_startCheck("warp_out"), d_a_warphr.cpp:171)
the developers' stage select lists ADMumi point 201 layer 9 and Hyrule point 200 layer 8 as cutscene starts (group 32 entries 21 and 41)
with 0x2D10 on and the Master Sword not equipped the King of Red Lions says 0xD65 and can't be boarded (daShip_c, d_a_ship.cpp:362-363, 483-484, 4224-4229): ladder rung 14
catalog: off in 19, on in 20
steps.notes: 0x2D10 is set when warp_in starts, i.e. by the bell's warp at the top of the Tower of the Gods, which part B ends with. If part B also lists it, keep it in one place when joining. daWarpf_c (the Tower's boss warp) also appears once 0x2D10 is on (d_a_warpf.cpp:230-233).

steps.label: Into Hyrule Castle

switches.why: spawn switch of Hyroom's event hy_intro (EVNT entry 2), started by Hyroom point 0 (parameters 0x02FF0000) the first time; Hyrule's exit leads to that point

evidence: Hyroom point 0 starts event 2, hy_intro (stage EVNT list), reached from Hyrule's exit (wwedit.disc_exits)
catalog: switch 0x12 on in 20

steps.label: The Triforce puzzle opens the way under the statue

switches.why: the Link statue YLzou (parameters 0x00000006: param_get_swSave = 6, d_a_obj_YLzou.h:23-29) waits to slide aside while switch 6 is off and stays moved once it is on (daObjYLzou_c::set_start_type, d_a_obj_YLzou.cpp:99-105)

evidence: the pushable triangle blocks MtryB / MtryBCr (d_a_obj_tribox: 'Hyrule Castle - Pushable triangle blocks') in Hyroom room 0 carry 6 in parameter bits 8-15 (0x00000600, 0x00010600); the decomp's tribox is Nonmatching, so that they set switch 6 is read from the parameters, not from code
catalog: switch 6 on in 20

steps.label: Pulling the Master Sword

switches.why: the hint tag TagHt2 in kenroom (parameters 0xFFFF0E4A: type 0x0A, switch 0x0E, message 0x045A) turns its switch on when it starts (daTag_Hint_c::startProc, d_a_tag_hint.cpp:443-460)

the event tag TagEv 0x000E0BFF (event 0 master_sword, waits for switch 0x0E, switch 0x0B) turns 0x0B on when its event starts (daTag_Event_c::arrivalTerms / actionReady, d_a_tag_event.cpp:51-72, 218-229); 0x0B is also master_sword's spawn switch (kenroom EVNT entry 0)

evidence: kenroom's event master_sword: EventFlag 11524 (0x2D04), then Hyroom point 248, layer 8 (kenroom event_list.dat; the decomp's note: 'Set by master_sword.stb (stage: kenroom)')
the sword in its pedestal (VmsMS, daObjVmsms_c) deletes itself when master_sword starts (d_a_obj_vmsms.cpp:74-80)
the developers' stage select: kenroom point 200 layer 8 'Before Master Sword' (group 32 entry 22)
catalog: off in 19, on in 20

steps.label: Colour returns to Hyrule

switches.why: spawn switch of Hyroom's event rebirth_hyral (EVNT entry 0)

evidence: Hyroom point 248 (parameters 0x00FF0000) starts rebirth_hyral; its .stb carries flag payload 0x31, which d_a_demo00's table maps to COLORS_IN_HYRULE (d_a_demo00.cpp:651-703; payload read from rebirth_hyral.stb, Demo49.arc); the event then goes to kenroom point 249, layer 10

COLORS_IN_HYRULE wakes the Darknut and Moblin statues in the castle (d_dozou, d_a_tn.cpp:2321-2326; d_a_mo2.cpp:2712) and moves kenroom to layer 6|7 until 0x3280 (dComIfG_play_c::getLayerNo, d_com_inf_game.cpp:242)
the developers' stage select: Hyroom point 248 layer 8 'Taking Master Sword' (group 32 entry 45)
catalog: off in 19, on in 20

steps.label: Link raises the Master Sword

switches.why: spawn switch of kenroom's event swing_sword (EVNT entry 2)

evidence: kenroom point 249 (parameters 0x02FF0000) starts swing_sword: EventFlag 14852 (0x3A04), then kenroom point 249, layer 6 (kenroom event_list.dat; the decomp's note: 'Set by swing_sword.stb')
swing_sword.stb carries item payload 0, which d_a_demo00's item table maps to dItemNo_MASTER_SWORD_1_e (d_a_demo00.cpp:715-735; payload read from Demo50.arc)
once the Master Sword is equipped the King's hint is 0xD66, 'preparations complete' (d_a_ship.cpp:480-481), and he can be boarded again (:4224-4229): ladder rung 15, no flag of its own
the developers' stage select: kenroom point 249 layer 10 'After Master Sword' (group 32 entry 46)
catalog: off in 19, on in 20 (Hero's Sword -> Master Sword (Powerless))

steps.label: The castle's statues come alive and are beaten

switches.why: ALLdie in Hyroom (parameters 0xFFFF04FF) turns switch 4 on once no enemy is left in the room (daAlldie_c::actionTimer, d_a_alldie.cpp:36-47)

evidence: the Darknut trap TnTrap in Hyroom (parameters 0x00000904, 0x00010804) appears once 0x3A04 is on (daObjTnTrap_c::chk_appear, compiled d_a_obj_tntrap.rel .text+0x118) and sets 0x3B40 (chk_event_flg, .text+0x938); the decomp's tntrap is Nonmatching; Hyroom's events break_tntrap / break_tntrap2 are its scenes
the statues on Hyroom's layers 0|1 (Tn, mo2 with spawn switch 0xFF) only move once COLORS_IN_HYRULE is on (d_a_tn.cpp:2321-2326)
with 0x3B40 Hyroom loads layer 6|7, which has none of them (getLayerNo, d_com_inf_game.cpp:234)
catalog: off in 19, on in 20
steps.notes: What the trap needs before it sets 0x3B40 (switch 4, or its own check of the enemies) isn't read: chk_event_flg is only in compiled form.

unplaced.notes: Area 9 switch 0x10 is on in catalog 20 and not tied to an actor yet. Not this part: 0x3810 (daWarphr_c on leaving Hyrule, d_a_warphr.cpp:203-207: the next arc's first step), the Hero's Bow, the heart container and the Command Melody and Tower flags (part B), Cyclos and the Ballad of Gales (between 20 and 21, the next arc). Later visits to these stages (to_awake_zl, awake_zelda, btl_of_swroom, seal) belong to later arcs.
